item.description:
标签: #AI编程 #智能体 #AI芯片 #大模型

摘要: Replit发布Agent 4支持并行AI代理协作构建全栈应用，AI编程工具Cursor寻求500亿美元估值，同时Meta加速部署自研芯片以减少对外部供应商依赖并降低AI算力成本。

原标题: Replit Agent 4 🤖, Cursor eyes $50B valuation 💰, Meta AI chips ⚡

Replit Agent 4 🤖, Cursor eyes $50B valuation 💰, Meta AI chips ⚡

# TLDR AI 2026-03-12

# TLDR AI 2026-03-12

Replit Agent 4 🤖, Cursor eyes $50B valuation 💰, Meta AI chips ⚡

Replit Agent 4 (2 minute read)

Replit launched Agent 4, introducing an infinite design canvas and the ability to run parallel AI agents to build backends and frontends simultaneously. The update shifts from pure code generation to a collaborative product suite capable of shipping web apps, databases, and slide decks within a single integrated environment.

Replit 发布了 Agent 4，引入了无限设计画布（infinite design canvas）以及运行并行 AI 智能体（AI agents）的能力，可同时构建后端（backends）和前端（frontends）。此次更新从纯粹的代码生成转向协作式产品套件，能够在单一集成环境中交付 Web 应用、数据库和幻灯片。

Meta Preparing to Deploy Four New Homegrown Chips to Handle AI (4 minute read)

Meta has announced four new chips as part of an effort to diversify its hardware sources, reduce reliance on outside chipmakers, and bring down costs. The MTIA 300 is already in production for content ranking and recommendations training. The MTIA 400 has completed lab testing and is moving toward deployment. The MTIA 450 and MTIA 500 chips are scheduled for mass deployment in 2027.

Meta 宣布了四款新芯片，作为其硬件来源多元化、减少对外部芯片制造商依赖并降低成本的努力的一部分。MTIA 300 已投入生产，用于内容排名和推荐训练。MTIA 400 已完成实验室测试，正朝着部署推进。MTIA 450 和 MTIA 500 芯片计划于 2027 年大规模部署。

AI Coding Startup Cursor in Talks for About $50 Billion Valuation (2 minute read)

Cursor is in talks with investors for a funding round that would value it at $50 billion, nearly double its valuation last fall. The discussions are preliminary and may not result in a funding deal. One of the fastest-growing startups of all time, Cursor is a central player in tech's vibe coding era. It has attracted financing from top names in venture capital and the tech industry. The company's last financing round, announced in November, boosted its valuation to $29.3 billion.

Cursor 正在与投资者洽谈一轮融资，该轮融资将其估值定为 500 亿美元，几乎是去年秋天估值的两倍。讨论尚处于初步阶段，可能不会达成融资协议。作为有史以来增长最快的初创公司之一，Cursor 是科技界 vibe coding（氛围编程）时代的核心参与者。它已吸引了来自风险投资界和科技行业顶级机构的融资。该公司于 11 月宣布的上一轮将其估值提升至 293 亿美元。

Perplexity's Personal Computer lets AI agents access your Mac mini's files (3 minute read)

Personal Computer is a version of Perplexity Computer that handles things on a nearby computer. It handles requests from users and directs multiple AIs to complete tasks. It is effectively a project manager that delegates tasks to other AIs before combining the results and presenting them. Perplexity has specifically named the Mac Mini as a platform that Personal Computer can run on. There is currently a waitlist for access.

Personal Computer 是 Perplexity Computer 的一个版本，可在邻近计算机（nearby computer）上处理事务。它处理用户请求并指挥多个 AI 完成任务。它实际上是一个项目经理，将任务委托给其他 AI，然后整合结果并呈现。Perplexity 特别指出 Mac Mini 是 Personal Computer 可运行的平台。目前访问需要排队等待（waitlist）。

How A Regular Person Can Utilize AI Agents (21 minute read)

Non-technical users can build functional agents by deploying API connectors and project-based instructions to automate high-cognitive tasks. This modular framework utilizes parallel subagents to execute complex workflows, shifting the user role from conversational prompter to systems architect.

非技术用户可以通过部署 API 连接器（API connectors）和基于项目的指令来构建功能性智能体，以自动化高认知任务。这种模块化框架利用并行子智能体（parallel subagents）执行复杂工作流，将用户角色从对话式提示者转变为系统架构师（systems architect）。

Designing Agents to Resist Prompt Injection (6 minute read)

OpenAI outlined how prompt injection attacks against agents increasingly resembled social engineering, and argued that defenses should focus not just on detecting malicious inputs but on limiting the impact of successful manipulation.

OpenAI 概述了针对智能体的 prompt injection（提示词注入）攻击如何越来越类似于社会工程学（social engineering），并认为防御措施不应仅专注于检测恶意输入，还应限制成功操控的影响。

👨‍💻

👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

Ready to tackle complex robotics problems? Solve this challenge, with $180K in prizes (Sponsor)

To accelerate the adoption of AI robotics, Intrinsic, Open Robotics, Google DeepMind, and NVIDIA are running a global competition for developers / roboticists: in sim using Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or MuJoCo. Finalists will deploy in a physical workcell at Intrinsic HQ, with top teams splitting a $180K prize pool. Sign-ups close April 17th, so today!

为了加速 AI 机器人技术的采用，Intrinsic、Open Robotics、Google DeepMind 和 NVIDIA 正在为开发者/机器人专家举办一场全球竞赛： 使用 Gazebo、Isaac Sim 或 MuJoCo 进行仿真（in sim）。决赛选手将在 Intrinsic 总部的实体工作单元（physical workcell）中部署，顶级团队将分享 18 万美元的奖金池。报名截止日期为 4 月 17 日，所以今天就报名吧！

Reasoning Expands Factual Recall in Language Models (23 minute read)

Google's controlled experiments showed that enabling reasoning improved single-hop factual recall in LLMs (Large Language Models) by acting as a computational buffer and by generating related facts that help retrieve answers, though hallucinated intermediate facts increased final-answer errors.

Google 的对照实验表明，启用推理通过充当计算缓冲区（computational buffer）并生成有助于检索答案的相关事实，提高了 LLM（大语言模型，Large Language Models）的单跳事实回忆（single-hop factual recall）能力，尽管幻觉化的中间事实（hallucinated intermediate facts）增加了最终答案的错误率。

How Autoresearch will change Small Language Models adoption (4 minute read)

Autoresearch is a tool that ingests a training script and a metric and then edits code, runs experiments, checks if the metric improved, keeps or discards, and repeats. It allows researchers to optimize models overnight, even without any machine learning experience. Andrej Karpathy used it to squeeze 11% more speed out of his GPT-2 training. Shopify's CEO used the tool to train a 0.8B model overnight that outscored his previous 1.6B model.

Autoresearch 是一种工具，它接收训练脚本和评估指标，然后编辑代码、运行实验、检查指标是否改善、保留或丢弃结果，并重复此过程。它允许研究人员在一夜之间优化模型，即使没有任何机器学习经验。Andrej Karpathy 使用他将 GPT-2 训练速度提升了 11%。Shopify 的 CEO 使用该工具在一夜之间训练了一个 0.8B 模型，其表现超过了之前的 1.6B 模型。

NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Super (48 minute read)

NVIDIA just released Nemotron 3 Super, a 120B open hybrid MoE (Mixture of Experts) model (12B active) designed for agentic and multi-agent AI systems.

NVIDIA 刚刚发布了 Nemotron 3 Super，这是一个 120B 参数的开源混合 MoE（Mixture of Experts，专家混合）模型（12B 激活参数），专为 agentic（具备智能体能力的）和多智能体（multi-agent）AI 系统设计。

Introducing The Anthropic Institute (5 minute read)

Anthropic has launched the Anthropic Institute to tackle AI's societal challenges. Guided by co-founder Jack Clark and an interdisciplinary team, key hires include Matt Botvinick for AI law, Anton Korinek for economic impacts, and Zoë Hitzig for economic connections. Anthropic has also expanded its Public Policy team to shape global AI governance, led by Sarah Heck with a new office in DC.

Anthropic 成立了 Anthropic Institute（Anthropic 研究院）以应对 AI 的社会挑战。在联合创始人 Jack Clark 和跨学科团队的指导下，关键 hires 包括负责 AI 法律的 Matt Botvinick、负责经济影响的 Anton Korinek，以及负责经济联系的 Zoë Hitzig。Anthropic 还扩展了其公共政策团队，由 Sarah Heck 领导，并在华盛顿特区（DC）设立了新办公室，以塑造全球 AI 治理。

The Department of War is making a huge mistake (27 minute read)

Large language models are probably not currently being used in mission-critical ways, but this will change within 20 years, when 99% of the workforce will be AIs. Our future civilization will run on AI labor. We need to think through some extremely important questions about who this future workforce will be accountable and aligned to, and who gets to determine that. The only way to preserve a free society is to make laws and norms saying it is unacceptable for the government to use AI to enforce mass surveillance, censorship, and control. Individual acts of corporate courage will not solve the problem.

大语言模型（Large language models）目前可能尚未以关键任务（mission-critical）方式使用，但这将在 20 年内改变，届时 99% 的劳动力将是 AI。我们未来的文明将运行在 AI 劳动力之上。我们需要深入思考一些极其重要的问题：这个未来的劳动力将对谁负责、与谁对齐（aligned），以及谁来决定这些。维护自由社会的唯一方法是制定法律和规范，明确规定政府使用 AI 实施大规模监控、审查和控制是不可接受的。个别企业的英勇行为无法解决这个问题。

摘要: Replit推出Agent 4进军知识工作代理领域，反映出2026年AI行业正经历从编程代理向全面知识工作自动化的关键转型，同时NVIDIA、Anthropic等也在加速布局Agent基础设施与模型能力。

原标题: [AINews] Replit Agent 4: The Knowledge Work Agent

[AINews] Replit Agent 4: The Knowledge Work Agent

Replit just tripled in valuation to $9B in the last 6 months. You can accuse Amjad Masad of many things, but you cannot deny he and his team's incredible pulse on what the "current meta" in tech is:

Replit在过去6个月里估值翻了三倍，达到90亿美元。你可以指责Amjad Masad很多事，但你无法否认他和他的团队对科技界"当前主流趋势"（current meta）有着惊人的敏锐嗅觉：

Perhaps if you're not close to Replit (eg you never saw their 2015 Master Plan or their Documentary), you might watch that 8 minute video and think it is a generic AI platform launch like any other. But this Replit is unrecognizable from the "coding with some AI tacked on" platform that Replit was just 2 years ago, with a bunch of now veritably antiquated conventional wisdoms of the time:

也许如果你不熟悉Replit（比如你从未看过他们2015年的总体规划或他们的纪录片），你可能会看了那段8分钟的视频，认为这只是又一个普通的AI平台发布。但现在的Replit与仅仅两年前那个"附带一些AI功能的编程"平台已经判若两人，当时的一堆传统观念如今看来确实已经过时：

Now that software engineering is approximately solved, where does a coding platform go? Well for Replit, it means going up the stack to be a fully integrated productivity suite, with a canvas, apps, sites, slides, videos, and others.

既然软件工程问题大致已被解决，编程平台该往何处去？对于Replit来说，这意味着向技术栈上层移动，成为一个完全集成的生产力套件（productivity suite），包含画布、应用、网站、幻灯片、视频等功能。

This is a smart pivot that is inline with one of the most dominant themes of 2026 - now that coding agents have solved coding, it is the same coding agent builders that are expanding their scope to more and more knowledge work tasks, including Pi → OpenClaw, Claude Code → Cowork, and every model lab working on Excel and PowerPoint integrations, and Notion building Custom Agents for every other knowledge work integration in the world.

这是一个聪明的转型，符合2026年最主流的主题之一——既然编程智能体（coding agents）已经解决了编程问题，正是这些编程智能体的构建者们正在将业务范围扩展到越来越多的知识工作（knowledge work）任务，包括Pi → OpenClaw、Claude Code → Cowork，以及每个模型实验室都在开发Excel和PowerPoint集成，还有Notion正在为世界上所有其他知识工作集成构建定制智能体（Custom Agents）。

Our Running Trends List of 2026 in AI

我们整理的2026年AI趋势清单

We have been somewhat accumulating a list of AI Trends that Matter in 2026 and it has slowly emerged through our coverage this year:

我们一直在积累一份2026年重要的AI趋势清单，它已随着我们今年的报道逐渐显现：

  • The Coding/Reasoning Discontinuity of December 2025

  • AI research automation (aka RSI, sometimes "AI Scientist")
  • World Models (AMI, Adversarial)
  • Memory Shortage and the Custom ASIC stack (incl Taalas)
  • The Great AI vs SaaS Rebundling
  • "AI for Science" finally working
  • Scaling without Slop

  • 2025年12月的编程/推理能力跃迁（The Coding/Reasoning Discontinuity）
  • 编程智能体 → 知识工作智能体（本文主题）
  • IDE的消亡 → "黑箱"软件工厂（Dark Software Factories）——无需代码审查
  • AI研究自动化（又称RSI（递归自我改进，Recursive Self-Improvement），有时称为"AI科学家"）
  • 世界模型（AMI、对抗式）
  • 内存短缺与定制ASIC芯片栈（包括Taalas）

AI Twitter Recap

AI Twitter回顾

NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Super Release and the Open-Model Efficiency Push

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super发布与开源模型效率推进

  • Nemotron 3 Super was the clearest technical release of the day: a 120B parameter / ~12B active open model with 1M context, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer / SSM Latent MoE architecture, and explicit support for agentic workloads. NVIDIA positioned it as unusually open — weights, data, recipe, infra details — and performance-focused for Blackwell-era deployment, with claims of up to 2.2x faster inference than GPT-OSS-120B in FP4 and large throughput gains over prior Nemotron releases (announcement via @ctnzr, tech perspective via @kuchaev, Wired reporting on NVIDIA's broader open-model investment).

  • Nemotron 3 Super是当天最清晰的技术发布：一个1200亿参数/约120亿激活参数的开源模型，支持100万token上下文（1M context），采用混合Mamba-Transformer/SSM潜空间MoE（混合状态空间模型-Transformer/SSM潜空间混合专家）架构，并明确支持智能体工作负载（agentic workloads）。NVIDIA将其定位为异常开放——权重、数据、配方、基础设施细节全部公开——并针对Blackwell时代的部署进行了性能优化，声称在FP4精度下推理速度比GPT-OSS-120B快达2.2倍，吞吐量相比之前的Nemotron版本也有大幅提升（发布声明via @ctnzr，技术视角via @kuchaev，Wired关于NVIDIA更广泛开源模型投资的报道）。

  • Third-party reactions converged on the same theme: strong capability-per-active-parameter and unusually high serving speed. @ArtificialAnlys scored it 36 on the AA Intelligence Index, ahead of gpt-oss-120b (33) but behind Qwen3.5-122B-A10B (42), while noting ~10% higher throughput per GPU than GPT-OSS-120B and launch-day serving speeds of up to 484 tok/s. Community and infra support landed immediately across vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, Together, Baseten, W&B Inference, LangChain, and Unsloth GGUFs.

  • 第三方反馈集中在同一主题：每个激活参数的强大能力（capability-per-active-parameter）和异常高的服务速度。@ArtificialAnlys在AA智能指数（AA Intelligence Index）上给了它36分，领先于gpt-oss-120b（33分）但落后于Qwen3.5-122B-A10B（42分），同时指出其每GPU吞吐量比GPT-OSS-120B高约10%，发布日服务速度高达484 token/秒。社区和基础设施支持立即覆盖vLLM、llama.cpp、Ollama、Together、Baseten、W&B Inference、LangChain和Unsloth GGUFs。

  • The most interesting technical discussion was about why it is fast. @ctnzr highlighted native multi-token prediction (MTP) as a key inference optimization: provisional multi-token guesses get verified on subsequent passes, exploiting otherwise-unused GPU compute at small batch sizes. @bnjmn_marie also quantified a major KV-cache advantage versus Qwen3.5-122B: roughly 8,192 bytes/token in BF16 for Nemotron's attention KV term versus 24,576 bytes/token for Qwen3.5-122B, making long-context serving materially lighter.

  • 最有趣的技术讨论是关于为什么它这么快。@ctnzr强调了原生多token预测（native multi-token prediction, MTP）是关键推理优化：临时的多token猜测在后续传递中得到验证，利用小批量大小下原本闲置的GPU计算资源。@bnjmn_marie还量化了相比Qwen3.5-122B的重大KV缓存优势（KV-cache advantage）：Nemotron的注意力KV项在BF16精度下约为每token 8,192字节，而Qwen3.5-122B为每token 24,576字节，这使得长上下文服务的负担大幅减轻。

Agent Infrastructure, Orchestration, and the "Bigger IDE" Thesis

智能体基础设施、编排与"更大的IDE"论点

  • The strongest product trend was a shift from "chat with a model" to persistent agent runtimes and orchestration layers. @karpathy argued the "age of the IDE is over" framing is wrong; instead, "we're going to need a bigger IDE" where the unit of work becomes an agent rather than a file, and later extended that into the notion of legible, forkable agentic orgs with real-time observability and control (follow-up, org legibility thread).

  • 最强劲的产品趋势是从"与模型对话"转向持久化智能体运行时（persistent agent runtimes）和编排层（orchestration layers）。@karpathy认为"IDE时代已经结束"的框架是错误的；相反，"我们需要一个更大的IDE"，其中工作单元变成智能体而非文件，随后他将这一概念扩展为具有实时可观察性和控制的可阅读、可分叉的智能体组织（legible, forkable agentic orgs）（后续跟进，组织可读性线程）。

  • Multiple launches fit that framing. Perplexity announced Personal Computer, an always-on local/cloud hybrid that runs on a Mac mini, works across local files/apps/sessions, and can be controlled remotely (launch, waitlist). It also expanded Computer for Enterprise, describing orchestration across 20 specialized models and 400+ apps (enterprise launch, API platform update). Separately, Replit Agent 4 pitched a more collaborative, canvas-like workflow with parallel agents for apps, sites, and slides (launch), while Base44 Superagents emphasized "batteries included" integrations with Gmail, Slack, Stripe, CRM, and more for nontechnical users (launch).

  • 多个发布符合这一框架。Perplexity宣布推出Personal Computer（个人电脑），一个运行在Mac mini上的始终在线的本地/云混合系统，可跨本地文件/应用/会话工作，并可远程控制（发布、候补名单）。它还扩展了企业版Computer，描述了对20个专用模型和400多个应用的编排（企业版发布、API平台更新）。另一方面，Replit Agent 4推出了更具协作性、类似画布的工作流，支持应用、网站和幻灯片的并行智能体（parallel agents）（发布），而Base44 Superagents则强调为非技术用户提供的"开箱即用"集成，包括Gmail、Slack、Stripe、CRM等（发布）。

  • The engineering discussion is increasingly around the harness, not just the model. @Vtrivedy10 described a fast-moving design space where improved models unlocked product experiences that were previously too brittle, with a self-improving loop of evals/metrics → autonomous harness edits → hill climbing. LangChain added autonomous context compression to Deep Agents so models can compact at task boundaries instead of hard token thresholds (announcement), while @OpenAIDevs published a technical writeup on computer access for agents, covering execution loops, filesystem context, network access, and guardrails.

  • 工程讨论越来越围绕控制框架（harness），而不仅仅是模型。@Vtrivedy10描述了一个快速演进的设计空间，其中改进的模型解锁了以前过于脆弱的产品体验，形成了评估/指标 → 自主框架编辑 → 爬坡优化（evals/metrics → autonomous harness edits → hill climbing）的自我改进循环。LangChain为Deep Agents添加了自主上下文压缩（autonomous context compression），使模型能在任务边界进行压缩，而非依赖硬性的token阈值（公告），同时@OpenAIDevs发布了一篇关于智能体计算机访问（computer access for agents）的技术文章，涵盖执行循环、文件系统上下文、网络访问和防护栏（guardrails）。

Anthropic, Claude-Centric Workflows, and Early RSI Anxiety

Anthropic、以Cl为中心的工作流与早期RSI焦虑

  • A major meta-story was Anthropic's institutional framing of powerful AI. The company launched The Anthropic Institute, led by Jack Clark in a new Head of Public Benefit role, with a mandate spanning ML engineering, economics, and social science to shape the public conversation around advanced AI (launch, leadership note, Jack Clark on role change).

  • 一个重要的元故事是Anthropic对强大AI的制度性框架。该公司成立了Anthropic研究所（The Anthropic Institute），由Jack Clark担任新的公共利益负责人（Head of Public Benefit）一职，其使命涵盖机器学习工程、经济学和社会科学，以塑造关于先进AI的公共对话（成立公告、领导层说明、Jack Clark关于职位变动的说明）。

  • At the same time, several tweets amplified concerns that Anthropic may be seeing early recursive-self-improvement dynamics internally. The most substantive references came indirectly via discussion of a TIME article: @kimmonismus summarized claims that 70–90% of the code used in developing future models is now written by Claude, model release cadence has compressed from months to weeks, and some researchers think fully automated AI research could be as little as a year away. @Hangsiin highlighted one especially striking line: Claude being 427x faster than human overseers at some internal tasks, with nested parallel usage patterns already common.

  • 与此同时，多条推文放大了对Anthropic内部可能出现早期递归自我改进动态（early recursive-self-improvement dynamics）的担忧。最有实质内容的引用间接来自对《时代》（TIME）杂志文章的讨论：@kimmonismus总结了相关说法，即开发未来模型所用代码的70-90%现在由Claude编写，模型发布周期已从数月压缩至数周，一些研究人员认为完全自动化的AI研究（fully automated AI research）可能仅剩一年之遥。@Hangsiin特别强调了一句格外引人注目的话：在某些内部任务上，Claude比人类监督员快427倍，嵌套并行使用模式已很常见。

  • This narrative had an immediate practical counterpoint: operational dependence on Claude Code. A login/auth outage triggered visible developer pain, with @Yuchenj_UW joking that Silicon Valley productivity fell 90%, @dejavucoder reporting inability to log in, and @HamelHusain describing fallback to token-based access. The outage even prompted @karpathy to note his autoresearch labs got wiped out in the OAuth outage, framing future frontier-model service interruptions as potential "intelligence brownouts."

  • 这一叙事有一个直接的实际反例：对Claude Code的运营依赖（operational dependence）。一次登录/认证中断引发了明显的开发者痛苦，@Yuchenj_UW开玩笑称硅谷生产力下降了90%，@dejavucoder报告无法登录，@HamelHusain描述了回退到基于token的访问。这次中断甚至促使@karpathy指出他的自动研究实验室在OAuth中断中被 wiped out，将未来前沿模型服务中断定性为潜在的"智能限电"（intelligence brownouts）。

Research on Agent Evals, Retrieval, Post-Training, and Self-Improvement

关于智能体评估、检索、后训练与自我改进的研究

  • Several papers focused on what looks like the next bottleneck: measuring and improving agent systems, rather than just base-model quality. @karinanguyen_ released PostTrainBench v1.0, a benchmark for whether frontier agents can post-train language models in a simplified setting, explicitly aimed at tracking progress toward AI R&D automation / recursive self-improvement. One notable ablation from the thread: for GPT-5.1 Codex Max, medium reasoning effort beat high, because extra tokens caused context compaction and hurt performance (ablation details).

  • 几篇论文聚焦于看起来像是下一个瓶颈的领域：测量和改进智能体系统，而非仅仅是基础模型质量。@karinanguyen_发布了PostTrainBench v1.0，这是一个用于测试前沿智能体能否在简化环境中后训练语言模型（post-train language models）的基准测试，明确旨在追踪向AI研发自动化/递归自我改进（AI R&D automation / recursive self-improvement）迈进的进度。讨论串中一个值得注意的消融实验：对于GPT-5.1 Codex Max，中等推理努力（medium reasoning effort）优于高等，因为额外的token导致了上下文压缩并损害了性能（消融细节）。

  • On the agent-learning side, @omarsar0 highlighted EvoSkill, where an executor/proposer/skill-builder triad discovers and refines reusable skills from failures; on OfficeQA it reportedly improved Claude Code + Opus 4.5 from 60.6% to 67.9% exact match. @dair_ai shared AgentIR, a reasoning-aware retriever that jointly embeds an agent's reasoning trace with its query; they report 68% accuracy on BrowseComp-Plus, versus 52% for larger conventional embedding models and 37% for BM25.

  • 在智能体学习方面，@omarsar0强调了EvoSkill，其中执行器/提议器/技能构建器三元组从失败中发现并优化可复用技能；在OfficeQA上，据报道它将Claude Code + Opus 4.5的精确匹配率从60.6%提高到67.9%。@dair_ai分享了AgentIR，一个推理感知检索器（reasoning-aware retriever），它将智能体的推理轨迹与查询联合嵌入；他们报告在BrowseComp-Plus上达到68%的准确率，相比之下，更大的传统嵌入模型为52%，BM25为37%。

  • There was also renewed emphasis on agent reliability as a security problem even without adversaries. @random_walker argued many AI-agent failures arise from unreliability rather than explicit attacks, pointing to a Princeton response to NIST on the need to define, measure, and mitigate that failure mode. Combined with the growing emphasis on eval craft — e.g. @gabriberton calling eval creation the most useful skill in the age of code agents — the center of gravity keeps shifting toward measurement, harnesses, and production feedback loops.

  • 人们也重新强调智能体可靠性作为安全问题，即使没有对抗者。@random_walker认为许多AI智能体故障源于不可靠性而非显式攻击，指出了普林斯顿对NIST的回应，即需要定义、测量和缓解这种故障模式。再加上对评估工艺（eval craft）日益增长的重视——例如@gabriberton称评估创建是编程智能体时代最有用的技能——重心持续转向测量、控制框架和生产反馈循环。

Multimodal Models, Embeddings, and Physical/Visual AI

多模态模型、嵌入与物理/视觉AI

  • On the multimodal side, Google's Gemini Embedding 2 drew practical pricing analysis rather than benchmark talk. @osanseviero summarized the release: embeddings for text, images, video, audio, PDFs, plus Matryoshka embeddings for lower-dimensional storage. @neural_avb offered the most useful deployment note: text pricing appears high relative to competitors, suggesting the model is best reserved for multimodal retrieval; video embedding costs can explode unless clients aggressively lower FPS before upload.

  • 在多模态方面，Google的Gemini Embedding 2引发了实用的定价分析而非基准测试讨论。@osanseviero总结了该发布：支持文本、图像、视频、音频、PDF的嵌入，外加用于低维存储的Matryoshka嵌入（Matryoshka embeddings）。@neural_avb提供了最有用的部署提示：相对于竞争对手，文本定价似乎偏高，表明该模型最好用于多模态检索（multimodal retrieval）；除非客户端在上传前大幅降低FPS（每秒帧数），否则视频嵌入成本可能会爆炸性增长。

  • Qwen3.5's multimodal architecture also got a detailed community breakdown from @ZhihuFrontier: a hybrid attention stack mixing Gated DeltaNet linear attention and Gated full attention, with a 397B A17B MoE variant and 27B dense variant, 262k native context extensible toward 1M, and MTP in training. That thread is useful mostly as a compact survey of where attention innovation is going: hybrid linear/full attention, GQA, DSA, and MoE routing are now core design axes.

  • Qwen3.5的多模态架构也得到了@ZhihuFrontier详细的社区拆解：混合注意力（hybrid attention）栈混合了门控DeltaNet线性注意力（Gated DeltaNet linear attention）和门控全注意力（Gated full attention），有397B A17B MoE（3970亿参数，170亿激活参数混合专家）变体和27B dense（270亿参数密集）变体，26.2万原生上下文可扩展至100万，训练时采用MTP（多token预测）。该线程主要作为注意力创新方向的紧凑调查而有用的：混合线性/全注意力、GQA（分组查询注意力）、DSA（动态稀疏注意力）和MoE路由现在是核心设计轴。

  • In vision/physical AI, Reka Edge launched as a production-focused VLM for physical AI, claiming 3x fewer input tokens and 65% faster throughput than leading 8B models across image/video understanding, object detection, and tool use (launch). item.title: [翻译] Construction Physics: 预制住宅的成本节约之困
item.description:
标签: #预制房屋 #建筑工业化 #住房成本

摘要: 文章指出，尽管预制房屋长期被视为降低建房成本、提升效率的解决方案，但历史实践证明其成本节约效果远不及预期（通常仅10-20%），且从Lustron到Katerra的多次大规模尝试均告失败，未能像汽车制造业那样彻底改变建筑行业。

原标题: The Elusive Cost Savings of the Prefabricated Home

The Elusive Cost Savings of the Prefabricated Home
预制房屋难以捉摸的成本节约

It’s long been believed the constantly rising costs of new home construction, and lackluster improvements in construction productivity more generally, are fundamentally a problem of production methods. Most houses in the US are still built on-site, using manual labor and hand tools, a manner of construction that doesn’t seem all that different from construction in the 19th century. By contrast, sectors like agriculture and manufacturing have shifted from this type of “craft production,” where work is done primarily by skilled manual labor, to industrialized, factory production, where work is mainly done by high-volume, highly automated machinery. Direct labor — the labor needed to actually physically produce something — makes up only about 10-12% of the cost to manufacture a modern car, while it’s roughly half of the cost of building a new single family home. Extending this line of thinking suggests that if construction could be similarly industrialized — if homes were built in factories and then delivered to their sites, rather than built on-site, by hand — we’d see the sorts of falling costs and rising productivity in construction that we’ve seen in manufacturing and agriculture.

长期以来，人们一直认为新房建造成本的持续上升，以及建筑生产率总体上乏善可陈的改进，从根本上说是生产方法的问题。美国的大多数房屋仍然是在现场建造，使用人工劳动和手工工具，这种建造方式似乎与19世纪的建造方式并无太大不同。相比之下，农业和制造业等部门已经从这种"手工艺生产（craft production）"（主要依靠熟练的手工劳动完成工作）转变为工业化、工厂化生产（主要依靠大批量、高度自动化的机械完成工作）。直接劳动——即实际生产某物所需的劳动——在现代汽车制造的成本中仅占约10-12%，而在建造新的独栋住宅的成本中约占一半。沿着这种思路延伸，如果建筑业能够实现类似的工业化——如果在工厂建造房屋然后运送到工地，而不是在现场手工建造——我们将在建筑业看到制造业和农业曾经出现过的那种成本下降和生产率提升。

The concept of industrializing homebuilding by bringing the process into the factory began to be articulated almost as soon as the benefits of mass production became apparent. Around the 1920s Alfred P. Sloan, president of General Motors, extolled the virtues of industrialized production, noting that an $800 Chevrolet would cost $5000 if it were made by hand, and suggested that the costs of building a home could be similarly and dramatically reduced using factory methods. In 1928, the German architect Walter Gropius noted that between 1913 and 1926 the price of new cars had halved, while the price of construction had doubled. Gropius later attributed this to the different production methods of car manufacturing and homebuilding, declaring that contemporary building methods were “far behind the times” and “not fit to solve the problem” of building affordable homes:

将住宅建筑工业化、将建造过程引入工厂的概念，几乎在大规模生产的好处一显现就开始被阐述。大约在1920年代，通用汽车（General Motors）总裁阿尔弗雷德·P·斯隆（Alfred P. Sloan）赞扬了工业化生产的优点，指出如果手工制造，一辆800美元的雪佛兰将花费5000美元，并认为使用工厂方法可以同样大幅降低建造成本。1928年，德国建筑师沃尔特·格罗皮乌斯（Walter Gropius）指出，1913年至1926年间，新车价格减半，而建筑价格却翻了一番。格罗皮乌斯后来将这归因于汽车制造和住宅建筑的不同生产方法，宣称当代建筑方法"远远落后于时代"，"不适合解决"建造经济适用房的问题：

The greater proportion of hand-work involved in building increased the price in accordance with the increasing labor costs. Refinement of mass production methods, on the other hand, considerably lowered the price of automobiles. A decent dwelling became unattainable for the poor, yet the car became an everyman’s tool.

建筑中涉及的更大比例的手工劳动随着劳动力成本的增加而提高了价格。另一方面，大规模生产（mass production）方法的改进显著降低了汽车价格。体面的住所对穷人来说变得遥不可及，然而汽车却成为了普通人的工具。

The potential efficiency gains and cost savings of factory-based construction have been a driver of numerous prefabricated — factory-built — homebuilding efforts. They were behind the Lustron Corporation, which received $37.5 million (over $500 million in 2026 dollars) in government funding to produce an enameled-steel panel home in an enormous former aircraft engine factory following WWII. They fuelled Operation Breakthrough, a 1970s US government initiative to kickstart the industrialized production of housing. They formed the core thesis of Katerra, a construction startup that in 2018 raised over $2 billion in venture capital on promises of driving down the costs of construction with factory methods (disclosure: I formerly managed an engineering team at Katerra).

工厂化建筑带来的潜在效率提升和成本节约一直是众多预制房屋——工厂建造住宅——建造努力的推动力。它们支撑了Lustron公司（Lustron Corporation），该公司在二战后获得了3750万美元（按2026年美元计算超过5亿美元）的政府资助，在一个巨大的前飞机发动机工厂生产搪瓷钢板住宅。它们推动了Operation Breakthrough（突破行动），这是1970年代美国政府启动住房工业化生产的倡议。它们构成了Katerra公司的核心论点，这家建筑初创公司在2018年筹集了超过20亿美元的风险投资，承诺用工厂方法降低建筑成本（披露：作者此前曾在Katerra管理一个工程团队）。

However, these hopes have yet to bear out, and achieving cost savings with prefabricated construction has proved to be highly elusive in practice. Factory-based building methods have been tried extensively both in the US and abroad, but it’s hard to find examples of prefabricators achieving significant cost savings above more traditional methods. The savings that have occurred are frequently in the realm of 10-20%, a far cry from the huge reductions that followed the industrialization of car manufacturing. Often these cost savings don’t materialize at all, and prefabricators instead emphasize other benefits of factory methods like reduced construction time and increased quality. In cases where major savings do occur — such as with mobile homes — it’s often within somewhat narrow categories of building that have not generalized to the broad construction market.

然而，这些希望尚未实现，在实践中，通过预制建筑（prefabricated construction）实现成本节约已被证明是非常难以捉摸的。工厂化建筑方法在美国和国外都进行了广泛的尝试，但很难找到预制建筑商实现比传统方法显著成本节约的例子。已实现的节约通常在10-20%的范围内，这与汽车制造业工业化后带来的巨大成本削减相去甚远。通常这些成本节约根本未能实现，预制建筑商转而强调工厂方法的其他好处，如缩短建造时间和提高质量。在确实出现重大节约的情况下——如活动房屋（mobile homes）——通常是在相对狭窄的建筑类别中，这些类别尚未推广到广泛的建筑市场。

What should we expect from factory-based homebuilding?
对工厂化住宅建筑应该有何期待？

Before we look at the history of cost savings with prefabricated construction, it’s worth articulating what, specifically, we might hope to gain by using factory-based construction methods.

在我们审视预制建筑成本节约的历史之前，有必要阐明我们具体希望通过使用工厂化建筑方法获得什么。

Prior to the age of mass-production, cars were assembled using craft production methods. In “The Machine that Changed the World”, a study of Japanese car manufacturing methods, the authors describe how cars were assembled at Panhard et Levassor, a French machine-tool company which at the end of the 19th century was the world’s leading car manufacturer:

在大规模生产时代之前，汽车是使用手工艺生产（craft production）方法组装的。在《改变世界的机器》（The Machine that Changed the World）这部研究日本汽车制造方法的著作中，作者描述了19世纪末世界领先的汽车制造商——法国机床公司Panhard et Levassor如何组装汽车：

P&L’s workforce was overwhelmingly composed of skilled craftspeople who carefully hand-built cars in small numbers…different contractors, using slightly different gauges, made the parts. They then ran the parts through an oven to harden their surfaces enough to withstand heavy use. However, the parts frequently warped in the oven and needed further machining to regain their original shape.When these parts eventually arrived at P&L’s final assembly hall, their specifications could best be described as approximate. The job of the skilled fitters in the hall was to take the first two parts and file them down until they fit perfectly. Then they filed the third part until it fit the first two, and so on until the whole vehicle — with its hundreds of parts — was complete…by the time the fitters reached the last part, the total vehicle could differ significantly in dimensions from the car on the next stand that was being built to the same blueprints.Because P&L couldn’t mass-produce identical cars, it didn’t try. Instead, it concentrated on tailoring each product to the precise desires of individual buyers.

P&L的劳动力主要由熟练的工匠组成，他们小心翼翼地手工少量制造汽车……不同的承包商使用略有不同的量规制造零件。然后他们将零件通过烘箱硬化其表面，以承受高强度使用。然而，零件经常在烘箱中变形，需要进一步加工才能恢复原来的形状。当这些零件最终到达P&L的总装车间时，其规格最好被描述为近似值。车间里熟练装配工的工作是拿起前两个零件，锉平它们直到完美配合。然后他们锉第三个零件直到它与前两个配合，如此反复，直到整辆车——拥有数百个零件——完成……当装配工做到最后一个零件时，整车的尺寸可能与旁边正在按相同蓝图建造的汽车有显著差异。因为P&L无法大规模生产相同的汽车，它也没有尝试。相反，它专注于根据每个买家的精确需求定制每个产品。

This was a time-consuming and labor intensive process, and cars produced in this manner were expensive: in the early 1900s a new car cost on the order of $2000 to $3000 ($77,000 to $116,000 today).

这是一个耗时且劳动密集的过程，以这种方式生产的汽车价格昂贵：在1900年代早期，一辆新车的成本约为2000至3000美元（相当于今天的77,000至116,000美元）。

Henry Ford and his systems of mass production changed all that. By introducing a series of manufacturing improvements — machine-made interchangeable parts, the moving assembly line, special-purpose automated machine tools — Ford was able to dramatically reduce the cost of producing a car. In 1908, Ford’s Model T cost $850, far less than competing cars. And as production methods improved and manufacturing scale increased, the costs fell even further: by 1925, a Model T was selling for just $260, a reduction of more than 80% in inflation-adjusted terms.

亨利·福特（Henry Ford）和他的大规模生产（mass production）系统改变了这一切。通过引入一系列制造改进——机器制造的可互换零件（interchangeable parts）、移动装配线（moving assembly line）、专用自动化机床——福特能够大幅降低汽车生产成本。1908年，福特的T型车（Model T）售价850美元，远低于竞争车型。随着生产方法的改进和制造规模的扩大，成本进一步下降：到1925年，T型车仅售260美元，按通胀调整后的术语计算，降幅超过80%。

Notably, the enormous reductions in cost didn’t come at the expense of quality. An analysis of Buick’s 1911 Model 10, a competitor of the Model T, noted that “[a]nyone comparing a Model T Ford side by side with a Model 10 Buick would be unable to find anything superior on the Buick other than it had more brass trim. The Buick is crudely constructed, in essence years behind a Model T Ford in terms of manufacturing ease and serviceability, performance, and reliability. The Buick Model 10 is slow, heavy, and small.” This increase in quality meant reduced maintenance costs; the Model T cost around $100 a year to maintain at a time when other cars cost $1500.

值得注意的是，成本的巨大降低并非以牺牲质量为代价。对T型车的竞争对手——别克（Buick）1911年款10型车的分析指出："任何将福特T型车与别克10型车并排比较的人，除了发现别克有更多的黄铜装饰外，找不到任何优越之处。别克制造粗糙，在制造便利性、可维修性、性能和可靠性方面实质上比福特T型车落后数年。别克10型车速度慢、重量大、体积小。"这种质量的提升意味着维护成本的降低；T型车每年的维护成本约为100美元，而当时其他汽车的维护成本为1500美元。

Since automobiles transitioned from craft to industrialized production, the cost of cars has continued to fall in inflation-adjusted terms. And we see this pattern more broadly with manufactured goods: they tend to get cheaper over time. If we look at categories of manufactured goods in the consumer price index over the last several decades, nearly all of them have fallen in price in real terms.

自从汽车从手工艺生产转变为工业化生产以来，汽车成本在通胀调整后的条件下持续下降。我们在制成品中更广泛地看到了这种模式：它们往往随时间推移变得更便宜。如果我们观察过去几十年消费者价格指数中的制成品类别，几乎所有类别的实际价格都下降了。

Notably, this shift to industrialized production isn’t dependent on the success of a single firm. Ford’s share of automobile sales peaked at around 60% of the US car market in the early 1920s, but by the 1930s it had fallen behind General Motors and Dodge, and by the middle of WWII the company “was on the brink of collapse,” to the point where the government considered taking it over. But even if Ford had gone out of business, the industry wouldn’t have shifted back to craft-methods of production. Similarly, a dramatic decline in the overall car market — car sales declined by about 75% during the Great Depression, and by nearly 50% following the global financial crisis — didn’t cause a shift back towards craft methods of production. Once industrialized production arrives, is benefits ensures that it sticks around even in the face of market downturns.

值得注意的是，向工业化生产的转变并不依赖于单一企业的成功。福特在美国汽车市场的销售份额在1920年代早期达到约60%的峰值，但到1930年代已落后于通用汽车和道奇，到二战中期该公司"处于崩溃边缘"，以至于政府考虑接管它。但即使福特倒闭，该行业也不会回到手工艺生产方法。同样，整个汽车市场的急剧下滑——大萧条期间汽车销量下降约75%，全球金融危机后下降近50%——也没有导致向手工艺生产方法的回归。一旦工业化生产到来，其利益确保它即使在市场低迷时期也能持续存在。

The promise of factory-based construction then, is that the new methods that are so superior, and result in such great decreases in cost while offering equal or even superior quality, that going back to the old methods is unthinkable, even in the face of major firm failures or market declines. People will often articulate other benefits of prefabricated construction, and these benefits are often real and valuable, but it’s the promise of durably improved efficiency and reduced cost that has continuously inspired enthusiasm for the concept.

因此，工厂化建筑的承诺在于，新方法如此优越，能够在提供同等甚至更高质量的同时大幅降低成本，以至于回到旧方法是不可想象的，即使面临重大企业失败或市场下滑。人们经常会阐述预制建筑的其他好处，这些好处通常真实且有价值，但正是对持久改善的效率和降低成本的承诺持续激发了人们对这一概念的热情。

A brief history of prefabricated homebuilding
预制房屋建筑简史

The history of prefabricated construction dates back hundreds of years. In 1624, English colonists brought a prefabricated panelized house with them when they arrived at Cape Ann, Massachusetts which was disassembled and reassembled several times.

预制建筑的历史可以追溯到数百年前。1624年，英国殖民者抵达马萨诸塞州安角（Cape Ann）时带来了一座预制板式房屋（panelized house），该房屋被拆卸和重新组装了多次。

During the California Gold Rush of 1848, thousands of prefab homes were exported to California from the eastern US as well as England, France, Germany, and even China: by 1850, 5000 homes had been ordered and shipped to California from the New York area alone. In 1861, the lumber dealers Skillings & Flint patented a “portable house” made of panelized wood construction which could be erected in three hours, many of which they sold to the Union Army during the Civil War. In 1892, Ernest Hodgson began to sell prefabricated cottages made from wood panels, which the company continued to sell in one form or another until the 1970s.1

在1848年加利福尼亚淘金热（California Gold Rush）期间，数千套预制房屋从美国东部以及英国、法国、德国甚至中国出口到加利福尼亚：到1850年，仅纽约地区就订购并向加利福尼亚运送了5000套房屋。1861年，木材经销商Skillings & Flint获得了一项由板式木结构制成的"便携房屋"专利，可在三小时内搭建完成，其中许多在内战期间卖给了联邦军队。1892年，欧内斯特·霍奇森（Ernest Hodgson）开始销售木制面板预制小屋，该公司以这种或那种形式继续销售直到1970年代。

But it was really in the 1930s when the idea of prefabrication as a strategy for reducing the costs of building a home began to emerge. The ongoing Depression, and the high costs of housing, had put homes out of reach for many Americans. The success of mass production, or “Fordism,” in driving down the costs of cars inspired many entrepreneurs to try a similar strategy with homebuilding. An article in the Brooklyn Daily Eagle from 1935 noted that “mass production of prefabricated housing promises to revolutionize homemaking for the average family.” One early example was the Motohome, which debuted that same year as the “prefabricated house that comes complete with food in the kitchen.” Promotional material for the Motohome noted that other goods had become cheap thanks to mass production, and it was only logical to apply such methods to homebuilding:

但实际上是在1930年代，作为降低建房成本策略的预制建筑理念才开始出现。持续的大萧条和高昂的住房成本使许多美国人无法拥有住房。大规模生产或"福特主义（Fordism）"在降低汽车成本方面的成功，激发了许多企业家尝试在住宅建筑中采用类似策略。1935年《布鲁克林每日鹰报（Brooklyn Daily Eagle）》的一篇文章指出，"预制房屋的大规模生产有望为普通家庭的家庭生活带来革命。"一个早期例子是Motohome，同年首次亮相，被称为"厨房里配有食物的预制房屋"。Motohome的宣传材料指出，其他商品因大规模生产而变得便宜，将这种方法应用于住宅建筑是合乎逻辑的：

THE greatest social and economic problem that has grown out of the depression has been the necessity of reducing the cost of homes to a price that is not out of balance with the price you pay for other necessities of life. Home building for years has remained on an antiquated basis. That is why the cost of homes has been going steadily higher and higher in relation to the cost of other things that have been lowered through the aid of mass production.It is obvious that by manufacturing homes on a mass-production basis, the cost can be brought down to a point where you may again afford to own your home and give your children their chance in life.

大萧条产生的最大社会和经济问题一直是必须将房屋成本降低到与你为其他生活必需品支付的价格不相失衡的水平。多年来，住宅建筑一直停留在过时的基础上。这就是为什么相对于通过大规模生产帮助降低的其他物品的成本，房屋成本一直在稳步上升。显然，通过以大规模生产的方式制造房屋，成本可以降低到你可以再次负担得起拥有房屋并给你的孩子人生机会的程度。

The Motohome was not particularly successful, selling only 150 units, and subsequent home designs from its manufacturer American Houses reduced the extent of prefabrication to “precutting [material] and partial preassembly of panels.”

Motohome并没有特别成功，仅售出150套，其制造商American Houses随后的房屋设计将预制程度降低到"材料预切割和部分面板预组装"。

But other prefab companies found more success. In 1934, Foster Gunnison, a salesman of lighting fixtures, founded “Gunnison Magic Homes” (later shortened to Gunnison Homes), which aimed to “bring the full benefits of mass production technology to a backwards industry.” Gunnison hired manufacturing experts from car manufacturing, and developed a system of panelized construction using stressed-skin plywood construction (where the plywood exterior carries the weight of the structure, rather than wood studs) first developed by the US Forest Products Laboratories. Gunnison aimed to make his company “the General Motors of the homebuilding field,” and by 1944 Gunnison Homes’ factories were producing 600 houses a month. And in 1940, brothers George and James Price founded National Homes, producing prefabricated wood panel homes in their factory in Lafayette, Indiana. Within two years, National Homes had produced over 3600 homes. Overall, between 1935 and 1940 prefabricators produced an estimated 10,000 homes in the US.

但其他预制公司取得了更大的成功。1934年，灯具销售员福斯特·冈尼森（Foster Gunnison）创立了"Gunnison Magic Homes"（后来简称为Gunnison Homes），旨在"将大规模生产技术的全部好处带给一个落后的行业"。冈尼森从汽车制造领域聘请了制造专家，并开发了一种使用蒙皮胶合板结构（stressed-skin plywood construction）（即胶合板外表面承载结构重量，而非木立柱）的板式建造系统，该方法最初由美国林产品实验室开发。冈尼森的目标是让他的公司成为"住宅建筑领域的通用汽车"，到1944年，Gunnison Homes的工厂每月生产600套房屋。1940年，乔治和詹姆斯·普莱斯（George and James Price）兄弟创立了National Homes，在印第安纳州拉斐特的工厂生产预制木板房屋。两年内，National Homes生产了超过3600套房屋。总体而言，1935年至1940年间，预制建筑商在美国生产了估计10,000套房屋。

Prefabricated construction gained further traction during WWII, when it was widely used to rapidly build homes for war workers moving into defense production areas. The 1942 Lanham Act authorized five manufacturers to produce 70,000 prefab homes for $153 million, and by 1943 there were at least 20 firms which had each manufactured more than 1000 houses, and several firms which were producing several hundred prefab homes a month. By the end of the war an estimated 200,000 prefabricated homes were built, roughly 12.5% of the 1.6 million homes built in America during the war.

预制建筑在二战期间获得了进一步的发展，当时它被广泛用于为迁入国防生产地区的战争工人快速建造住房。1942年的《兰哈姆法案》（Lanham Act）授权五家制造商以1.53亿美元生产70,000套预制房屋，到1943年，至少有20家公司每家生产了超过1000套房屋，几家公司每月生产数百套预制房屋。到战争结束时，估计建造了200,000套预制房屋，约占战争期间美国建造的160万套房屋的12.5%。

Following the war, US housing expediter Wilson Wyatt planned to use prefabrication to rapidly build large numbers of homes to address an “acute housing shortage”: 250,000 prefab houses were planned for 1946, and 600,000 for 1947. This didn’t come to pass — Wyatt resigned after less than a year, and the actual number of prefabs built in 1947 was around 25-35,000. But by the 1950s prefab construction was nevertheless beginning to carve out a meaningful, and increasing, fraction of the US housing market. In 1954 prefabs were around 5-8% of total single family home construction; by 1959 that fraction had risen to 6-12%.

战后，美国住房特派员威尔逊·怀亚特（Wilson Wyatt）计划使用预制建筑快速建造大量房屋，以解决"严重的住房短缺"：1946年计划建造250,000套预制房屋，1947年计划建造600,000套。这并未实现——怀亚特任职不到一年就辞职了，1947年实际建造的预制房屋数量约为25,000至35,000套。但到了1950年代，预制建筑仍然开始在美国住房市场中占据有意义且不断增长的份额。1954年，预制房屋约占独栋住宅建筑总量的5-8%；到1959年，这一比例上升到6-12%。

Many of these prefab homes were mobile homes: permanently occupied travel trailers. But prefabricated construction of conventional homes was also becoming more popular. National Homes, in particular, became a force to be reckoned with in the prefab industry. In 1953 National Homes produced just over 14,000 homes, roughly 2% of all US houses built. In 1959, the company merged with seven other prefabricators, giving it a network of nine plants across the US (some of which it was eventually forced to divest thanks to an anti-trust lawsuit). In 1956 the company had produced its 100,000th home; by 1960, it had hit 200,000, and by 1963 a quarter of a million. Founder James Price had the audacious goal of being responsible for 50% of ALL US housing starts by 1975.

这些预制房屋中有许多是活动房屋（mobile homes）：永久占用的旅行拖车。但传统房屋的预制建筑也越来越受欢迎。特别是National Homes，成为预制行业中不可忽视的力量。1953年，National Homes生产了超过14,000套房屋，约占美国建造房屋总数的2%。1959年，该公司与其他七家预制建筑商合并，在美国拥有九家工厂的网络（其中一些最终因反垄断诉讼被迫剥离）。1956年，该公司生产了第100,000套房屋；到1960年，达到200,000套；到1963年，达到25万套。创始人詹姆斯·普莱斯（James Price）有一个大胆的目标：到1975年承担美国所有住房开工量的50%。

During the 1960s mobile homes, today known as manufactured homes, also began to rapidly gain in popularity. Mobile home sales rose from 90,000 in 1960 to nearly 600,000 in 1972, at which point there were mobile home factories in 45 states. By 1974, Skyline, the largest mobile home manufacturer in the US, was producing 50,000 homes a year, more than any other homebuilder, and the Mobile Home Manufacturer’s Association had become the world’s largest land developer as part of its efforts to build new mobile home parks. By the early 1970s, mobile homes along with other types of prefabricated, factory-built construction made up on the order of half (and possibly more) of all single family home construction.

在1960年代，活动房屋（今天称为 manufactured homes（制造房屋））也开始迅速普及。活动房屋销量从1960年的90,000套上升到1972年的近600,000套，当时45个州都有活动房屋工厂。到1974年，美国最大的活动房屋制造商Skyline每年生产50,000套房屋，超过任何其他住宅建筑商，活动房屋制造商协会已成为世界上最大的土地开发商，作为其建设新活动房屋公园努力的一部分。到1970年代早期，活动房屋连同其他类型的预制工厂建造建筑约占所有独栋住宅建筑的一半（可能更多）。

But the early 1970s proved to be the peak of factory-built housing in the US. During the 1970s, many prefab firms went out of business or otherwise struggled. In 1972 the largest prefab factory in the US, owned by Behring Corporation, closed. Gunnison Homes, which had been purchased by US Steel in 1944, stopped producing homes in 1974. EL Hogdson similarly went out of business in the 1970s. National Homes entered a period of decline, losing $10 million in 1973 and $20 million in 1974, though the company managed to remain in business until the 1980s. Operation Breakthrough, a major government effort to kickstart large-scale production of factory-built housing, failed; despite $72 million in investment (plus millions more in Section 236 financing), 20 of the 22 building systems funded by Breakthrough were no longer being produced by the 1980s. Between 1973 and 1976 the number of mobile home factories in the US declined by nearly 40%, and the number of wood panel home factories declined by nearly 60%.

但1970年代早期被证明是美国工厂建造住房的顶峰。在1970年代，许多预制公司倒闭或以其他方式挣扎求生。1972年，Behring Corporation拥有的美国最大的预制工厂关闭。1944年被美国钢铁公司收购的Gunnison Homes于1974年停止生产房屋。EL Hogdson同样在1970年代倒闭。National Homes进入衰退期，1973年亏损1000万美元，1974年亏损2000万美元，尽管该公司设法维持运营直到1980年代。Operation Breakthrough（突破行动），一项启动工厂建造住房大规模生产的重要政府努力，失败了；尽管投资了7200万美元（再加上数百万美元的236条款融资），突破行动资助的22个建筑系统中有20个在1980年代已不再生产。1973年至1976年间，美国活动房屋工厂数量下降了近40%，木板房屋工厂数量下降了近60%。

Since the 1970s, prefab has continued to gradually lose ground in the US housing market. Cardinal Industries, which was the largest prefab homebuilder in the US following the demise of National Homes, declared bankruptcy in 1989. By 1990, mobile homes (which had since been confusingly renamed “manufactured homes”) and other prefabs together were down to around 20% of the US single family home market, and almost certainly a much smaller share of the multifamily apartment market. Manufactured homes saw an uptick in popularity through the 1990s, buoyed by lax lending standards, but sales collapsed in the early 2000s as lending standards tightened and repossessed homes flooded the market. Other types of prefabricated homes declined significantly following the 2008 Global Financial Crisis.2

自1970年代以来，预制建筑在美国住房市场中持续逐渐失地。在National Homes倒闭后成为美国最大预制房屋建筑商的Cardinal Industries于1989年宣布破产。到1990年，活动房屋（此后被令人困惑地更名为"制造房屋"）和其他预制房屋加起来仅占美国独栋住宅市场的20%左右，在多户公寓市场中的份额肯定要小得多。制造房屋在1990年代因宽松的贷款标准而受欢迎程度有所上升，但在2000年代初期，随着贷款标准收紧和被收回的房屋涌入市场，销量崩溃。其他类型的预制房屋在2008年全球金融危机后显著下降。

In the 2010s, there was a raft of US startups which spent enormous amounts of money to try and bring factory-based methods to homebuilding. In addition to Katerra ($2 billion), there was Veev ($475 million), Blu Homes ($217 million), Mighty Buildings ($100 million), Entekra ($75 million), and others. These companies all went out of business or otherwise failed (Mighty Buildings, for instance, pivoted to selling exterior cladding systems).

在2010年代，有一批美国初创公司花费巨额资金试图将工厂化方法引入住宅建筑。除了Katerra（20亿美元）之外，还有Veev（4.75亿美元）、Blu Homes（2.17亿美元）、Mighty Buildings（1亿美元）、Entekra（7500万美元）等。这些公司都倒闭了或以其他方式失败了（例如，Mighty Buildings转向销售外墙覆层系统）。

Today, prefabricated construction remains a small fraction of overall homebuilding in the US. For single family homes it’s around 10%, most of which are manufactured homes. For multifamily apartments, it’s roughly 3%.

今天，预制建筑在美国整体住宅建筑中仍占很小比例。对于独栋住宅，约占10%，其中大部分是制造房屋。对于多户公寓，大约占3%。

Thus the lack of a robust prefab housing construction industry in the US is not for lack of trying. Many firms have taken swings at being the “Henry Ford” of housing: often these firms have been backed by very substantial investments, and many of them have produced thousands of homes. But none of them have catalyzed a transformation of the American homebuilding industry the way that Ford did for the car industry.

因此，美国缺乏强大的预制住宅建筑行业并非因为缺乏尝试。许多公司都试图成为住宅建筑领域的"亨利·福特（Henry Ford）"：这些公司通常得到非常可观的投资支持，其中许多公司生产了数千套房屋。但没有一家公司像福特对汽车行业那样催化美国住宅建筑行业的转型。

Prefab outside the US
美国以外的预制房屋

Prefabricated home construction has a similarly long history of use outside the US. In the UK, following WWII the government funded the construction of over 150,000 prefabricated homes as part of its “Emergency Factory Made” housing program. The most notable of these was the AIROH house, which was designed to make use of now-surplus aircraft manufacturing plants and the 100,000 tons of scrap aluminum that no longer needed to be turned into airplanes. Over 54,000 aluminum-framed AIROH houses were produced during the program, each one using two tons of scrap aluminum.

预制住宅建筑在美国以外也有同样悠久的使用历史。在英国，二战后政府资助建造了超过150,000套预制房屋，作为其"紧急工厂制造（Emergency Factory Made）"住房计划的一部分。其中最著名的是AIROH房屋，该房屋旨在利用现在过剩的飞机制造厂和不再需要制成飞机的100,000吨废铝。该计划期间生产了超过54,000套铝框架AIROH房屋，每套使用两吨废铝。

More recently, the UK government has poured enormous amounts of investment to encourage the adoption of prefabricated construction (what they refer to as “Modern Methods of Construction” or MMC). As in the US, this effort has been marked by numerous high-profile failures and bankruptcies. Tophat, a modular builder formed in 2016, secured over £160 million (~$215 million) in funding, then operated at a loss between 2020 and 2023 before declaring bankruptcy. Legal & General, a financial services company, formed a prefab homebuilding division in 2016; by the time it closed in 2023, it had lost £236 million (~$316 million). Ilke Homes, a modular homebuilder founded in 2017, closed in 2023 owning £320 million (~$429 million) in debt. Today, prefab construction remains a small fraction of the UK’s homebuilding industry, around 5-10%.

最近，英国政府投入巨额资金鼓励采用预制建筑（他们称之为"现代建筑方法（Modern Methods of Construction）"或MMC"）。与美国一样，这一努力伴随着众多备受瞩目的失败和破产。成立于2016年的模块化建筑商Tophat获得了超过1.6亿英镑（约2.15亿美元）的资金，然后在2020年至2023年间亏损运营，最终宣布破产。金融服务公司Legal & General于2016年成立了预制房屋建筑部门；到2023年关闭时，已亏损2.36亿英镑（约3.16亿美元）。成立于2017年的模块化房屋建筑商Ilke Homes于2023年关闭，负债3.2亿英镑（约4.29亿美元）。今天，预制建筑在英国住宅建筑行业中仍占很小比例，约为5-10%。

In Germany, prefab construction has had more success. Millions of precast concrete apartments were built in East Germany during the Cold War, and since the 1990s prefabricated construction (much of it using wood-panel construction) has gradually become more popular. From less than 10% of new housing units in 1990, prefab today accounts for more than 25% of new German homes.

在德国，预制建筑取得了更大的成功。冷战期间，东德建造了数百万套预制混凝土（precast concrete）公寓，自1990年代以来，预制建筑（其中许多使用木板建造）逐渐变得更为流行。从1990年占新住房单元不到10%，到今天预制建筑占德国新房屋的25%以上。

Japan has similarly built large numbers of prefabricated homes. Prefabricated construction began to gain popularity in the 1960s, and by the 1970s Japan was producing over 100,000 prefabricated homes annually. Since the 1960s more than 10 million prefab homes have been built in Japan, and prefab makes up roughly 15% of the Japanese housing market.

日本同样建造了大量预制房屋。预制建筑在1960年代开始流行，到1970年代日本每年生产超过100,000套预制房屋。自1960年代以来，日本已建造了超过1000万套预制房屋，预制建筑占日本住房市场的约15%。

But the country that has adopted prefabrication more than any other country is Sweden. Roughly 85% of single family homes, and 30-40% of multifamily apartments in Sweden are prefabricated.

但采用预制建筑超过任何其他国家的是瑞典（Sweden）。瑞典大约85%的独栋住宅和30-40%的多户公寓是预制的。

It’s clear, then, that factory-based construction methods have been tried extensively, both in the US and around the world. It’s also equally clear that, in general, these methods have not displaced conventional construction. Outside of a few Scandinavian countries, prefabrication does not appear to be the primary method of homebuilding used in any major country.

因此，很明显，工厂化建筑方法在美国和世界各地都进行了广泛的尝试。同样清楚的是，总体而言，这些方法并未取代传统建筑。除了少数斯堪的纳维亚国家外，预制建筑似乎并不是任何主要国家使用的主要住宅建筑方法。

Prefab’s record of cost savings
预制房屋的成本节约记录

One major reason for the relative lack of success of prefab construction is cost. Unlike car manufacturing, where industrialized methods rapidly and dramatically reduced the cost to manufacture a car, the cost savings yielded by prefabricated construction have historically been much more modest, if indeed they’ve occurred at all.

预制建筑相对缺乏成功的一个主要原因是成本。与汽车制造不同，在汽车制造中工业化方法迅速且显著地降低了汽车制造成本，而预制建筑带来的成本节约历史上要温和得多，如果真的发生过的话。

The chart below shows the price per square foot of prefabricated homes built by different US manufacturers in the 1950s. It also includes the price per square foot of a typical conventionally-built US home in the 1950s.

下图显示了1950年代不同美国制造商建造的预制房屋的每平方英尺价格。它还包括1950年代典型传统建造美国房屋的每平方英尺价格。

And this chart shows the price per square foot of several prefabricated homes (not including land) circa 1947.

这张图表显示了1947年左右几套预制房屋（不包括土地）的每平方英尺价格。

We can see that most prefabricated homes cost roughly as much, or more, than conventional construction. Only six of the 22 1950s homes have a lower square-foot cost than conventional construction, and none of the 1947 homes are.3 And the lower costs that do exist are somewhat modest, ranging from 5-20%. What’s more, some of this cost savings comes from prefabricated homes having fewer features, rather than any sort of factory-based productivity improvement. National Homes’ 1953 catalog, for instance, notes that to keep prices low, “certain minor features come to you unfinished.” The National Homes low-cost “Cadet” model didn’t include interior paint, had a concrete or plywood floor in lieu of things like carpet or tile, had no closet doors, and had no attic or garage (though a carport could be added for an extra fee).

我们可以看到，大多数预制房屋的成本与传统建筑大致相同或更高。1950年代的22套房屋中，只有6套的每平方英尺成本低于传统建筑，而1947年的房屋中则没有一套低于传统建筑。而且确实存在的较低成本也相对温和，范围在5-20%之间。更重要的是，这些成本节约部分来自于预制房屋功能较少，而不是任何类型的工厂化生产率改进。例如，National Homes 1953年的目录指出，为了保持低价，"某些次要功能以未完成状态交付"。National Homes的低成本"Cadet"型号不包括内墙涂料，使用混凝土或胶合板地板代替地毯或瓷砖等物品，没有壁橱门，也没有阁楼或车库（尽管可以额外付费添加车棚）。

Skipping ahead to the late 1960s and 1970s, we see a similar pattern. The 1969 report “Building the American City” from the presidentially-appointed Douglas Commission included a section on factory-based construction methods. It estimated the potential savings of a fully factory-built house as being around 16.5% when compared to conventional construction. Likewise, the 1975 publication “Good Shelter: A Guide to Mobile, Modular, and Prefabricated Houses” notes that in 1972 the average prefab home cost on average $9 to $12 per square foot. This is a substantial savings of 33-50% compared to the average cost of conventional home construction (around $18 per square foot that year), but it’s likely an outlier; the same publication gives prices of $18 to $20 per square foot for 1974, only slightly less than the average conventional cost of around $21 per square foot that year. A 1977 issue of the homebuilder publication “House and Home” gives a typical prefab house cost of $15 to $17 per square foot, plus the cost of shipping. This is substantially less than the typical conventional construction cost that year (around $29 per square foot), but that’s the cost the builder pays the factory, and doesn’t include any of the necessary site work (foundations, utilities), the cost to install or finish the home, or the builder’s profit margin. Once these are added in, the cost advantage becomes more marginal: the article notes that that price allows the builder to be competitive with conventional building methods, and offer some modest cost savings (which trades off against the reduced flexibility of prefab construction).4 It states that builders choose prefab to “get houses up quickly, or to sell in remote areas where assembling crews for conventional building would be difficult, or to control costs more accurately,” not for any major cost savings.

跳到1960年代末和1970年代，我们看到了类似的模式。总统任命的道格拉斯委员会（Douglas Commission）在1969年的报告《建设美国城市》（Building the American City）中包含了一个关于工厂化建筑方法的章节。它估计完全工厂建造的房屋与传统建筑相比，潜在节约约为16.5%。同样，1975年的出版物《良好居所：活动房屋、模块化房屋和预制房屋指南》（Good Shelter: A Guide to Mobile, Modular, and Prefabricated Houses）指出，1972年预制房屋的平均成本为每平方英尺9至12美元。与传统住宅建筑的平均成本（当年约为每平方英尺18美元）相比，这节省了33-50%，但这可能是一个异常值；同一出版物给出1974年的价格为每平方英尺18至20美元，仅略低于当年传统建筑平均成本约每平方英尺21美元。1977年住宅建筑商出版物《房屋与家》（House and Home）的一期给出典型预制房屋成本为每平方英尺15至17美元，外加运费。这大大低于当年典型的传统建筑成本（约每平方英尺29美元），但这是建筑商支付给工厂的成本，不包括任何必要的现场工作（地基、公用设施）、安装或完工成本，或建筑商的利润率。一旦将这些加入，成本优势就变得更为边缘：文章指出，该价格使建筑商能够与传统建筑方法竞争，并提供一些适度的成本节约（这要与预制建筑灵活性降低进行权衡）。文章指出，建筑商选择预制建筑是为了"快速建造房屋，或在偏远地区销售（在那里组建传统建筑队伍会很困难），或更准确地控制成本"，而不是为了任何重大的成本节约。

Operation Breakthrough, an ambitious government program to industrialize US homebuilding, provides another example of limited cost savings of prefabricated construction. Breakthrough began in 1969, and funded the development and construction of 22 housing systems (out of several hundred applicants) in the hopes that some of them would eventually achieve true mass production. Several thousand Breakthrough housing units were constructed at demonstration sites around the country, and HUD financed the construction of tens of thousands more under its Section 236 program for low-income housing.

Operation Breakthrough（突破行动）是一项使美国住宅建筑工业化的雄心勃勃的政府计划，它提供了预制建筑成本节约有限的另一个例子。突破行动始于1969年，资助了22个住房系统（从数百个申请者中选出）的开发和建造，希望其中一些最终能实现真正的大规模生产。在全国示范建造了数千套突破行动住房单元，住房与城市发展部（HUD）在其针对低收入住房的236条款（Section 236）计划下资助了数万套住房的建造。

As part of the program, the housing system producers estimated the cost of the systems they were developing. Only 5 of the 22 systems estimated their costs would be less than conventional construction, and once again these estimated savings were modest, on the order of 5 to 20%. And it seems unlikely that in practice these savings were achieved: the government paid tens of millions of dollars to the demonstration site developers to cover the excess costs of the housing systems beyond their market价值, and by the 1980s 20 of the 22 housing systems (including every “low cost” system) were no longer in production.

作为该计划的一部分，住房系统生产商估计了他们正在开发的系统的成本。22个系统中只有5个估计其成本会低于传统建筑，而且再一次，这些估计的节约是适度的，约为5%至20%。而且在实践中这些节约似乎不太可能实现：政府向示范场地开发商支付了数千万美元，以弥补住房系统超出其市场价值的超额成本，到1980年代，22个住房系统中的20个（包括每个"低成本"系统）已不再生产。

By the 1980s, US prefab homebuilders had largely given up trying to compete by offering low-cost homes, a segment which was increasingly dominated by mobile homes. From a 1981 article in House and Home:

到1980年代，美国预制房屋建筑商已基本放弃通过提供低成本房屋来竞争，这一细分市场越来越多地被活动房屋主导。来自1981年《House and Home》杂志的一篇文章：

[National Association of Home Manufacturers’ John] Kupferer agrees, and gladly passes the affordability banner on: “Mobile homes really have the answer when it comes to affordable housing.” And instead of that revolution, Kupferer sees modular’s share of the housing market growing via evolution.The thrust of this evolution, says Kupferer, is that “dollar for dollar, yo

十年前，[工厂建造住房的]旗帜是"可负担性"，它营造了一个即将引发革命的行业形象，这场革命将让传统住宅建筑行业——以 supposedly 过时的建筑方法艰难前行——大吃一惊。那场革命从未到来……Boise Cascade运营经理约翰·巴克斯特（John Baxter）表达的 sentiment 是该行业现在如何看待自己的典型代表。"模块化住房在未来十年不会成为经济适用房的答案，"巴克斯特说。全国家庭制造商协会（National Association of Home Manufacturers）的约翰·库普费勒（John Kupferer）同意这一观点，并欣然接过可负担性旗帜："说到经济适用房，活动房屋才是真正的答案。"库普费勒没有看到那场革命，而是看到模块化住房通过渐进演变来增加其在住房市场中的份额。库普费勒说，这种演变的核心是"每一美元…

People have been asking me to sit on the other side of the mic for a long time. With my wife's debut children's book,Charts for Babies, coming out next month, we figured: why not do it together? What followed was one of the most honest conversations I've had on this podcast. Michelle asked things no one else would think to ask—and many things I've never shared publicly. 我认为正在发生的情况是这样的：AI-assisted coding（AI 辅助编程）正在揭示开发者之间一道始终存在但或许不那么明显的分歧。在 AI 出现之前，两个阵营的人每天都在做着同样的事情。手写代码。使用相同的编辑器、相同的编程语言、相同的 pull request 工作流。热爱工艺的人（craft-lovers）和追求"能跑就行"的人（make-it-go people）坐在一起，发布相同的产品，看起来毫无差别。工作背后的动机是隐形的，因为过程完全相同。现在到了分岔路口。你可以让机器来写代码，自己专注于指导要构建什么；或者你可以坚持手工精心编写。突然间，你最初进入这个领域的理由变得清晰可见，因为两个阵营在那个岔路口做出了不同的选择。

原标题: Coding After Coders: The End of Computer Programming as We Know It

Coding After Coders: The End of Computer Programming as We Know It

《程序员之后：我们所熟知的计算机编程的终结》

I think the piece accurately and clearly captures what's going on in our industry right now in terms appropriate for a wider audience.

我认为这篇文章准确而清晰地捕捉了我们行业目前正在发生的事情，表达方式也适合更广泛的受众。

I talked to Clive a few weeks ago. Here's the quote from me that made it into the piece.

几周前我与Clive（克莱夫）交谈过。以下是我被收录进文章的一段话。

Given A.I.'s penchant to hallucinate, it might seem reckless to let agents push code out into the real world. But software developers point out that coding has a unique quality: They can tether their A.I.s to reality, because they can demand the agents test the code to see if it runs correctly. "I feel like programmers have it easy," says Simon Willison, a tech entrepreneur and an influential blogger about how to code using A.I. "If you're a lawyer, you're screwed, right?" There's no way to automatically check a legal brief written by A.I. for hallucinations — other than face total humiliation in court.

鉴于A.I.（人工智能）容易产生hallucinations（幻觉）的倾向，让agents（智能体）将代码推送到真实世界似乎有些鲁莽。但软件开发者指出，编程具有一种独特的特质：他们可以将A.I.与现实联系起来，因为他们可以要求这些agents测试代码以验证其是否正确运行。"我觉得程序员很轻松，"科技创业者、关于如何使用A.I.编程的有影响力博主Simon Willison（西蒙·威利森）说道，"如果你是律师，你就完蛋了，对吧？"除了可能在法庭上完全丢脸之外，没有办法自动检查由A.I.撰写的法律简报是否存在hallucinations（幻觉）。
